page.content:
Covert-operations specialist and Flint's partner in the field.

How Lady Jaye connects

  • Faction: G.I. Joe team — Lady Jaye is a covert-operations specialist of the G.I. Joe team.
  • Character: Flint — Lady Jaye and Flint are paired in the field and on the Sunbow show.

What is Lady Jaye?

Lady Jaye is Alison R. Hart-Burnett, the Joe impersonator and javelin fighter whose file card and cartoon pairing with Flint sit in the team's second-wave command.

Key threads lead to G.I. Joe team and Flint.
